title: Your Dog Doesn't Scoop Water (Slow Motion Explained)
description:
Your dog doesn't scoop water with its tongue. It curls it backwards, slaps the surface, yanks it up so fast that a column of water follows, and bites the top off. Researchers filmed 19 dogs to work it out.

The mess? Leftover water in the curled tongue gets flung out the sides. Cats use the same column trick, just gently.

Sources:
- S. Gart, J. J. Socha, P. P. Vlachos and S. Jung, 'Dogs lap using acceleration-driven open pumping', Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (December 2015).
- Virginia Tech News, 'Engineers discover precise mechanism underlies the sloppy way dogs raise water into their mouths', 15 Dec 2015, news.vt.edu/articles/2015/12/121515-engineering-dogresearch.html

How it's made: original 3D characters and scenes, animated by us. The voices are AI voices (ElevenLabs).

Counterphysical: animal science that breaks your intuition.
